Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on the vacation itinerary (June 10-20, 2024), here's what to pack:

- Swimwear (for beach days at Waikiki Beach, snorkeling at Hanauma Bay, and kayaking at Kailua Beach)
- Sunscreen (essential for all outdoor activities)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike on June 13)
- Casual outfits (for daily wear and luau experience)
- Camera (to capture memories of Pearl Harbor, North Shore, and other activities)
- Travel documents (passport/ID, hotel reservations, flight information)
- Comfortable walking shoes (for sightseeing and hiking)
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Beach towel
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can also rent at Hanauma Bay)
- Waterproof phone case or bag
- Reusable water bottle
- Hat and sunglasses
- Insect repellent
- Personal toiletries and medications
- Beach bag
- Flip flops/sandals
- Formal attire (if needed for any special dinners)
- Charging cables and adapters
- Small backpack for day trips
